text: The point O is on the fixed horizontal line l. Points A and B on l are such that OA = 0.1 m and

Lan starts a new job on Monday. He will catch the bus to work every day from Monday to Friday
inclusive. The probability that he will get a seat on the bus has the constant value p. The random
variable X denotes the number of days that Lan will catch the bus until he is able to get a seat. The
probability that Lan will not get a seat on the Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday of his first
week is 0.4096.
